title: Weighing Therapeutic Benefits & Ethical Risks
goal: Contrast indicative and subjunctive after a pesar de que / pese a que and use pese a + noun or perfect infinitive.

items: I can contrast indicative (established fact) and subjunctive (hypothetical or backgrounded objection) after *a pesar de que* and *pese a que*.
I can compress a formal concession with *pese a* + noun or *pese a haber* + past participle.
I can discuss side effects, gene therapy, placebos, efficacy and biomedical research.
